claims: Venezuela won their first-ever World Baseball Classic title
The game was at loanDepot park in Miami
Eugenio Suárez hit a go-ahead RBI double in the top of the ninth inning
Eugenio Suárez's RBI double broke a 2-2 tie
Bryce Harper hit a two-run homer for the U.S. in the eighth inning
Daniel Palencia was the winning pitcher
Daniel Palencia recorded his second consecutive save
Venezuela maintained a 2-0 lead for most of the game
Maikel Garcia hit a sacrifice fly
Wilyer Abreu hit a solo homer
Venezuela finished the tournament with a 6-1 record
Venezuela had a quarterfinal win over Japan
The U.S. team had only three hits
The U.S. team had a second consecutive WBC final loss
